INSERT INTO core.audit_log (actor_account_id, actor_name, action, target, details)
        VALUES (
            $1,
            COALESCE($5, (SELECT c.name FROM core.accounts a
                          JOIN core.characters c ON c.id = a.main_character_id
                          WHERE a.id = $1)),
            $2, $3, $4
        )
